course_name_original: Gestion de production par la méthode MRP
course_name_en: Production management using the MRP method

learning_outcomes.text: Understand and apply the basic principles of MRP (Manufacturing Resource Planning), the most widely used production management method.

syllabus_topics: General information, History - Issues, Data: technical data, flow data, macro-data
MRP method, MRP functions (PIC, PDP, CBN)
MRP functions (PdC, Scheduling, Launching, Tracking), Application conditions

assessment_methods.method: DS1 (presumably a written exam or test)

bibliography: Courtois A., Pillet M. et Martin C., Gestion de production. Eyrolles. 2006
Javel G., L'organisation et la gestion de production, Dunod. 2010.
Giard V., Gestion de la Production et des Flux, Economica, 2003.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
